title: 第5章 金手指
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
午后的阳光透过木窗棂，就在林奇趴在桌上准备小憩一会时，一道厚重的阴影突然覆了上来挡住了阳光。

    “店家，卡兽肉收不收？”

    林奇抬起头来，视线里撞进一个高大的身影。

    那人裹着一身鞣制得发硬的兽皮，兽皮边缘还沾着未清理干净的血渍与草屑，裸露的小臂肌肉虬结，古铜色的皮肤上布满深浅不一的疤痕。

    这般猎户模样的打扮，在城区里实属罕见。

    “卡兽肉？这种东西我们……”

    林奇习惯性地想摆手拒绝。

    城里的肉铺大多只收家养牲畜，低阶卡兽肉大多又腥又韧，除非是高阶卡兽，否则很少有人问津。

    可话刚说到一半，他的目光扫过壮汉肩头扛着的卡兽，到了嘴边的话又硬生生咽了回去。

    “叔，您这卡兽准备怎么卖？按斤称还是按个？”

    壮汉皱着眉挠了挠后脑勺，兽皮袖子蹭得头发更乱了。

    他常年在山里捕猎，只懂以物换物，哪琢磨过这些买卖门道，干脆把卡兽往地上一放，闷声道：

    “俺不懂啥斤两，就按个卖。你说，这一个能给多少钱？”

    林奇蹲下身，捏了捏卡兽的绒毛。

    他皱起眉，一副为难的样子：“叔，这狐狸卡兽在山里挺常见的，肉少还骚气，一般也就给十五卡恩。看您跑这么远来城里，我给您凑个整，二十卡恩怎么样？”

    “二十？”

    那大汉皱了皱眉，为了逮这只卡兽，他在林子里追了大半天，还被爪子挠破了胳膊，本以为能多换些钱，没想到只有这么点。

    林奇一脸平静，耐着性子劝道：

    “大叔您别不高兴，实在不行你可以去西街的肉铺问问，顶多也就这15卡恩，甚至人家都不收的。

    二十卡恩不少了，能买一大袋子黑面包，再打一壶麦酒，够您吃好几天了。可这卡兽肉，您自己烤着吃，既费功夫又填不饱肚子，多不划算。”

    那大汉想了想觉得也有道理，把这狐狸烤了他也吃不饱，但20卡恩却能够让他买很多黑面包还有麦酒了。

    沉默片刻后，他重重一点头。

    “行，就二十卡恩！”

    林奇笑着拿出一张面值二十的卡恩，同时接过那狐狸卡兽。

    卡兽的尸体还带着余温，皮毛摸起来有些扎手。

    转身从门后取下“休息”的木牌挂在门外，林奇接着提着卡兽快步往厨房走去。

    “卡兽肉里面含有微弱源力，就算我的猜测错了，那这肉烤了吃也值10卡恩，亏得不多。”林奇一边嘀咕，一边把卡兽放在青石灶台上。

    身为开杂货店的商人，他最擅长的就是从寻常物件里找不寻常。

    这只狐狸卡兽看起来很普通，但是，林奇发现了它尾巴有些不一样。

    “正常的狐狸尾巴应该是棕色的，可这卡兽的尾巴却是粉色，这也太奇怪了。”
content_en:
The afternoon sunlight filtered through the wooden window lattice, and just when Lynch was lying on the table ready to take a nap, a thick shadow suddenly covered him, blocking the sunlight.

    "Store, do you accept card animal meat?"

    Lin Qi raised his head and saw a tall figure in his sight.

    The man was wrapped in a hard tanned animal skin, and the edges of the animal skin were still stained with uncleaned blood stains and grass clippings. His exposed forearm muscles were tangled, and his bronze skin was covered with scars of varying depths.

    Dressing up like an Orion is rare in the city.

    "Kanmeat? With this kind of thing, we..."

    Lynch habitually wanted to wave his hands and refuse.

    Most butcher shops in the city only accept domestic livestock, and the meat of low-level animals is mostly fishy and tough. Unless it is a high-level animal, few people care about it.

    But just in the middle of his words, his eyes glanced at the card beast carried on the shoulders of the strong man, and he swallowed the words when they reached his lips.

    "Uncle, how are you going to sell this card beast? By weight or by pieces?"

    The strong man frowned and scratched the back of his head, his animal skin sleeves rubbing his hair even more messily.

    He has been hunting in the mountains all year round, and only knows how to exchange things for things. He has never thought about these trading methods, so he simply put the stuck beast on the ground and said in a low voice:

    "I don't know what the price is, so I sell it by the piece. Tell me, how much can I get for this one?"

    Lin Qi knelt down and pinched the card beast's fur.

    He frowned and looked embarrassed: "Uncle, this fox beast is quite common in the mountains. It has little meat and is very aggressive, so it usually only gives fifteen kahn. Seeing that you have come all the way to the city, I will give you the whole package. How about twenty kahn?"

    "Twenty?"

    The big man frowned. In order to catch this stuck beast, he chased it in the forest for a long time, and even scratched his arm with his claws. He thought he could get more money in exchange, but he didn't expect it was only this much.

    Lin Qi looked calm and patiently advised:

    "Uncle, don't be upset. If it doesn't work, you can go to the butcher shop on West Street and ask. At most, it's only 15 kahn, and they won't even charge you.

    Twenty kahn is quite a lot. It can buy you a big bag of black bread and a jug of ale, which is enough for you to eat for several days. But if you roast the meat yourself and eat it, it takes a lot of effort and won't fill your stomach. It's not cost-effective. "

    The big man thought about it and thought it made sense. Even if the fox was roasted, he wouldn't be full, but 20 kahn allowed him to buy a lot of black bread and ale.

    After a moment of silence, he nodded heavily.

    "Okay, just twenty kahns!"

    Lin Qi smiled and took out a card with a face value of twenty, and at the same time took the fox card beast.

    Kashou's body was still warm, and its fur felt prickly.

    Turning around, he took down the "rest" wooden sign from behind the door and hung it outside. Then he quickly walked to the kitchen with the card beast in hand.

    "The Kamon meat contains a weak Source Power. Even if my guess is wrong, then the meat is worth 10 Karns when roasted. It's not a big loss." Lin Qi muttered as he placed the Kamon on the bluestone stove.

    As a businessman who runs a grocery store, what he is best at is finding the unusual among ordinary objects.

    This fox card beast looked ordinary, but Lynch discovered that its tail was a little different.

    "A normal fox's tail should be brown, but this beast's tail is pink. This is so strange."
